default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win11cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win11cis_rule_2_3_7_6 }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\LegalNoticeCaption:
    title: "2.3.7.6 | Configure 'Interactive logon: Message title for users attempting to log on' | LegalNoticeCaption"
    exists: true
    value: '{{ .Vars.win11cis_legal_notice_caption }}'
    type: REG_SZ
    meta:
      workstation: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 2.3.7.6
      NIST800-53R5:
        - AC-8
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/cis_2.3.7.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/cis_2.3.7.x/cis_2.3.7.6.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win11cis_legal_notice_caption is the policy setting specifies the text displayed in the title bar of the window that users see when they log on to the system. Configure this setting in a manner that is consistent with the security and operational requirements of your organization.
odvs.name: legal_notice_caption

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.6 | PATCH | Configure Interactive logon Message title for users attempting to log on"
  when: win11cis_rule_2_3_7_6
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.7.6
    - NIST800-171_3.1.9
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-8
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Currentversion\Policies\System
    name: LegalNoticeCaption
    data: "{{ win11cis_legal_notice_caption }}"
    type: string
